graders.name: keeps-steps
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`. The six deploy steps keep their meaning: CI check, image build with the tag, deploy with production needing the user's go-ahead, rollout watch with the 5-minute timeout, smoke test that must exit 0, and the report.

graders.name: names-the-action
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`. The pointer names the action, such as "follow `references/rollback.md`" or "apply ...", rather than spelling out steps the agent takes on its own, such as "open `references/rollback.md`, read it, and then follow it".

graders.name: pointer-has-condition
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`. The pointer to `references/rollback.md` now fires when it is needed: it sits where a failure shows up (the rollout, smoke-test or deploy step) or is otherwise tied to a condition the agent recognizes without opening the file, such as a rollout timeout, crash-looping pods or a failed smoke test, and it tells the agent to roll back instead of retrying. Pass also if the rollback procedure was inlined instead, as long as it is complete; fail if the pointer still has no recognizable condition.

graders.name: reference-unchanged
graders.description: The rollback reference and the rest of the repo stay as they are.

graders.name: sharpened-not-inlined
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`. The fix sharpens the pointer and its condition rather than copying the rollback procedure into SKILL.md: SKILL.md does not restate the rollback commands, log collection or migration warning from `references/rollback.md`. A one-line instruction to roll back rather than retry is fine.
